headline: Diplo brought an unreleased X track into PlaqueBoyMax’s stream, giving fans a rare listen
body: Diplo brought an unreleased X track into PlaqueBoyMax’s stream, giving fans a rare listen to music the two worked on together Via: The preview has people thinking about X’s 2017–2018 run, when his genre-blending sound was everywhere and new music could shift from aggressive to melodic in an instant. Hearing this track now has fans wondering how it might’ve landed back then and why it never officially came out.

Diplo brought an unreleased X track into PlaqueBoyMax’s stream, giving fans a rare listen to music the two worked on together 🕊️🥹

Via: @plaqueboymax 
The preview has people thinking about X’s 2017–2018 run, when his genre-blending sound was everywhere and new music could shift from aggressive to melodic in an instant. Hearing this track now has fans wondering how it might’ve landed back then and why it never officially came out.

PlaqueBoyMax’s stream turned into an unexpected place to revisit a piece of X’s unreleased catalog. Would you want the full track to drop? 👀
